evidence_snippets: By default, user-defined log-based metrics are calculated from all logs received by the Logging API for the Google Cloud project, regardless of any inclusion filters or exclusion filters that might apply to the Google Cloud project.
System-defined metrics Logging provides a set of metrics for usage values such as the number of log entries stored in log buckets in your project, or the number of bytes you've exported.
Every minute, for each stream, the Logging backend uses the values of the in-memory counters to determine how to update a time series that is managed by Cloud Monitoring.
